parameters.name: HTCapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the HT capabilities of the radio as defined by the HTCapabilities TLV {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.8}}.

parameters.name: VHTCapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the VHT capabilities of the radio as defined by the VHTCapabilities TLV {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.9}}.

parameters.name: HECapabilities
parameters.description: Describes the HE capabilities of the radio as defined by the HECapabilities TLV {{bibref|EasyMesh|Section 17.2.10}}. {{deprecated|2.15|because it is superseded by {{object|WiFi6APRole}} and {{object|WiFi6bSTARole}}}} {{obsoleted|2.17}} {{deleted|2.18}}

parameters.name: MSCSCapability
parameters.description: This parameter indicates support for Mirrored Stream Classification Service (MSCS) and EasyMesh configuration of MSCS {{bibref|EasyMesh|AP Radio Advanced Capabilities TLV}}.

parameters.name: SCSCapability
parameters.description: This parameter indicates support for Stream Classification Service (SCS) and EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} configuration of SCS {{bibref|EasyMesh|AP Radio Advanced Capabilities TLV}}.

parameters.name: QoSMapCapability
parameters.description: This parameter indicates support for QoS Map {{bibref|EasyMesh|AP Radio Advanced Capabilities TLV}}.

parameters.name: DSCPPolicyCapability
parameters.description: This parameter indicates support for DSCP Mapping Table TLV based DSCP-to-UP mapping and EasyMesh distribution of QoS Map elements to associated STAs {{bibref|EasyMesh|AP Radio Advanced Capabilities TLV}}.

parameters.name: SCSTrafficDescriptionCapability
parameters.description: This parameter indicates support for QoS Management Stream Classification Service (SCS) Traffic Description and EasyMesh configuration of and/or extensions to SCS using traffic descriptions {{bibref|EasyMesh|AP Radio Advanced Capabilities TLV}}.

object.description: This object represents the capabilities of the radio which may be different from the current operational configuration.
